title: AST Research for Terminal Sanitization in fspec-tui

typescript_reference.description: Strips ANSI escape sequences, replaces tabs with spaces, removes carriage returns, removes control characters (0x00-0x08, 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x0E-0x1F, 0x7F)

functions.handle_tool_result: Line 140 - Appends tool result content to scrollback. Currently only replaces tabs (line 178). NEEDS sanitization.
functions.handle_tool_progress: Line 210 - Folds streaming progress chunks. NEEDS sanitization.
functions.append_assistant_text: Line 21 - Appends assistant text. Could contain ANSI from tool output echoed back.

functions.wrap_source: Line 53 - Converts ChunkSource into pre-wrapped Lines. No sanitization applied.
functions.wrap_tool_call: Line 129 - Renders tool call bodies. Strips STDERR_MARKER but no ANSI stripping.

functions.wrap_to_width: Line 30 - Wraps text to width. No sanitization applied.

functions.normalize_line_endings: Line 18 - Only normalizes CRLF/CR to LF. No ANSI/control char stripping.

module_structure.new_module: sanitize.rs - will contain sanitize_for_terminal() and strip_ansi()

cargo_deps.regex: Already a workspace dependency (used in codelet/fspec-core)
cargo_deps.unicode_width: Not needed - sanitize only needs basic char filtering

integration_points: mod.rs - add `mod sanitize;` to module declarations
